changelog: Added GetPlayerNeeds and SetPlayerNeeds server exports for universal cross-framework hunger and thirst state management.
New SetInventoryBusy client export: lets a script lock the RP inventory (and holster the weapon) while a player is in a special mode.
/conf_acn_bridge is now a full in-game control panel: change almost every setting live, saved directly into config.lua, no restart needed.
Added centralized economy engine (acn_economy) integration with fail-closed safety.
New economy exports for stock reservations, purchases, ledger records, and diagnostics.
Camera (CCTV) actions sent from a player's game are now rate limited and validated.
New dirty money, police, and server callback exports.
